## Evidence-first review of PR #4 (riatzukiza/rheos) — head `7a39ec1`

Reviewed the complete immutable diff (74 files, 43/43 pages read and assessed) with full reads of the changed source, tests, workflow, and contract documentation.

**Deterministic evidence:** all seven gates green on the exact head with a clean checkout — `git diff --check` clean, lint 0 errors/warnings, test 173 tests / 1269 assertions / 0 failures, build 4 release targets / 0 warnings, and the new `source_dependencies` gate running the pinned source bootstrap successfully (this addresses the PR's self-reported earlier hosted run whose test/build failures were caused by the caller omitting that bootstrap — an invocation issue, not a defect in this diff).

**Confirmed findings: none.** Five candidates were registered and each was independently disproved:

- Unreachable `:malformed-uuid` branch in `admit-update` — the shape gate provably precedes it (Malli `:re` partial-match semantics proven by the green multi-character-uuid mutation test); dead defensive code with no failure trace.
- Receipt rows 1–4 failing external Receipt River strict timestamp validation — no in-repo validator or gate consumes the file; the limitation is prominently disclosed, makes no cumulative-pass claim, and rewriting historical rows would violate the append-only immutability the journal contract itself requires.
- Literal `--text` comment payload — append-only ledger truthfully recorded an operator mistake that a correction comment immediately follows; no code consumes comment text.
- `.gitignore` hiding bootstrap-materialized `deps/` roots — CI clean checkouts regenerate them from pinned SHAs via the tracked, unchanged bootstrap script; gitignore cannot hide tracked-file changes, and real tampering vectors stay diff-visible.
- GitHub App secrets reachable by PR-head code — `pull_request` trigger withholds secrets from fork PRs; same-repo authors already hold write access; read-only token permissions and SHA-pinned external workflow/revisions.

**The core change** (new pure `domain/law/shape.relationships` namespaces: normalization, full-snapshot graph admission, mixed-batch updates) was traced end-to-end against its documented contract. Its riskiest branches carry unusually strong tests — exhaustive 64-dependency/27-parent graph suites against an independent reachability oracle, cross-host Unicode-whitespace equivalence, permutation-order invariance, refusal-atomicity assertions, and a 1200-node non-recursion test — and independent tracing found no surviving failure trace. No production caller is wired yet (writer story is deliberately left Incoming).

**Non-blocking notes:** (1) `relationships.cljc:206` is dead defensive code — consider removing it or unifying uuid validation; (2) the disclosed receipt-timestamp compatibility batch remains open human-decision work; (3) the workflow's 125-skip failure branches are unexercised; (4) the repository has no lockfile at base, so install is unlocked by existing policy; (5) the board-projection RED (read-board drops parent/epic/dependency/type) is retained, honestly documented, and scoped to the Incoming parity story.
